title: Grusch: Oppenheimer helped set up UFO secrecy

tellings.quote: Oppenheimer, somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered, right?

plain: J. Robert Oppenheimer was reportedly one of the people who helped set up the secret UFO effort that a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower named David Grusch says he uncovered. Grusch says this on the show, calling Oppenheimer "somebody purportedly involved" in standing it up. If true, the secrecy would go back to the 1940s, the same years as the atomic bomb project.
